1: // Space Debris Dodge
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
7: 
8: // Ship definition
9: const ship = {
10:   width: 30,
11:   height: 20,
12:   x: canvas.width / 2,
13:   y: canvas.height - 40,
14:   speed: 4,
15:   boostTimer: 0,
16:   draw() {
17:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
18:     ctx.beginPath();
19:     ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
20:     ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
21:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
22:     ctx.closePath();
23:     ctx.fill();
24:   }
25: };
26: 
27: let debris = [];
28: let powerUps = [];
29: let score = 0;
30: let gameOver = false;
31: let spawnCounter = 0;
32: let powerCounter = 0;
33: 
34: // Input handling
35: const keys = {};
36: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
37: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
38: 
39: function spawnDebris() {
40:   const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
41:   debris.push({
42:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
43:     y: -size,
44:     size,
45:     speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 + score / 1000 // accelerate with score
46:   });
47: }
48: 
49: function spawnPowerUp() {
50:   const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'boost' : 'clear';
51:   powerUps.push({
52:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - 20),
53:     y: -20,
54:     size: 20,
55:     speed: 2,
56:     type
57:   });
58: }
59: 
60: function update() {
61:   if (gameOver) return;
62: 
63:   // Move ship
64:   if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
65:   if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
66:   if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
67:   if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
68:   // Keep inside canvas
69:   ship.x = Math.max(ship.width / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width / 2, ship.x));
70:   ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.height, ship.y));
71: 
72:   // Boost timer decrement
73:   if (ship.boostTimer > 0) ship.boostTimer--;
74: 
75:   // Spawn debris gradually
76:   spawnCounter++;
77:   if (spawnCounter > 30) { // roughly every 0.5 sec at 60fps
78:     spawnDebris();
79:     spawnCounter = 0;
80:   }
81: 
82:   // Occasionally spawn power‑ups
83:   powerCounter++;
84:   if (powerCounter > 600) { // every ~10 sec
85:     spawnPowerUp();
86:     powerCounter = 0;
87:   }
88: 
89:   // Update debris positions
90:   debris.forEach(d => d.y += d.speed);
91:   // Remove off‑screen debris and increase score
92:   debris = debris.filter(d => {
93:     if (d.y - d.size > canvas.height) {
94:       score++;
95:       return false;
96:     }
97:     return true;
98:   });
99: 
100:   // Update power‑ups
101:   powerUps.forEach(p => p.y += p.speed);
102:   powerUps = powerUps.filter(p => p.y - p.size < canvas.height);
103: 
104:   // Collision detection
105:   const shipRect = {x: ship.x - ship.width / 2, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height};
106:   for (let i = 0; i < debris.length; i++) {
107:     const d = debris[i];
108:     if (rectIntersect(shipRect, {x: d.x, y: d.y, w: d.size, h: d.size})) {
109:       gameOver = true;
110:       break;
111:     }
112:   }
113:   // Power‑up collection
114:   for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
115:     const p = powerUps[i];
116:     if (rectIntersect(shipRect, {x: p.x, y: p.y, w: p.size, h: p.size})) {
117:       if (p.type === 'boost') {
118:         ship.boostTimer = 300; // 5 seconds at 60fps
119:         ship.speed = 8;
120:       } else if (p.type === 'clear') {
121:         debris = [];
122:       }
123:       powerUps.splice(i, 1);
124:     }
125:   }
126:   // Reset speed after boost ends
127:   if (ship.boostTimer === 0) ship.speed = 4;
128: }
129: 
130: function draw() {
131:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000014';
132:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
133:   // stars background (simple static)
134:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
135:   for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
136:     const sx = Math.random() * canvas.width;
137:     const sy = Math.random() * canvas.height;
138:     ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1, 1);
139:   }
140: 
141:   ship.draw();
142: 
143:   // Draw debris
144:   ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
145:   debris.forEach(d => {
146:     ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.size, d.size);
147:   });
148: 
149:   // Draw power‑ups
150:   powerUps.forEach(p => {
151:     ctx.fillStyle = p.type === 'boost' ? 'yellow' : 'cyan';
152:     ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
153:   });
154: 
155:   // Score
156:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
157:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
158:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
159: 
160:   if (gameOver) {
161:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
162:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
163:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
164:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
165:   }
166: }
167: 
168: function rectIntersect(a, b) {
169:   return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
170: }
171: 
172: function loop() {
173:   update();
174:   draw();
175:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
176: }
177: 
178: // Start the game
179: loop();

(End of file - total 179 lines)
</content>
